shares_evidence_assessment: Every observation carries its own filed date. Of 142 issuers with CommonStockSharesOutstanding in the 220-issuer sample, 136 (96%) carry more than one distinct filed date. Median 36 observations per issuer; date span 2009–2026. This is genuine filed-stamped history, not a current scalar.
fallback_concept_and_rule: dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding present in 70% of sample (155/220) with 97% carrying multiple filed dates (150/155). Fallback is legitimate; executor may use dei concept to fill CommonStockSharesOutstanding gaps, explicitly noting the substitution.
restatement_rule: Latest-filed-as-of-decision-date (inherited from r58_pit_fundamental_panel_v1). For any decision date t, select the most recent observation whose filed <= t. Both original and restated values remain in companyfacts.zip; executor logic must filter to latest filing date per fiscal period. Example: Byrna Technologies CIK0001354866, fiscal end 2010-11-30 filed twice (2011-10-17 and 2012-03-13) with different values; use the 2012-03-13 value if t >= 2012-03-13, else use 2011-10-17.
non_positive_share_filter: Pre-registered filter applied BEFORE any issuance ratio or cross-sectional rank is computed: drop all observations with CommonStockSharesOutstanding <= 0. This is not a discovered rule at evaluation time; it is declared and must be hardcoded. Rationale: negative or zero shares produce spurious ratio values and extreme ranks. Example: Byrna end=2010-11-30 val=-25878050 later corrected to +25878050; the negative value, if included in a year-over-year issuance ratio, creates an enormous false signal.
PIT_AVAILABILITY_RULE: Filing date ('filed' field in companyfacts.json). Availability instant = the date the fact was filed with SEC, not the fiscal-period date or acceptance timestamp. Facts are available for decision use only as of and after their filed date.
expected_cross_section_note: CommonStockSharesOutstanding present in 142/220 issuers (65%); dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding present in 155/220 (70%). Missing observations must be handled explicitly in cross-sectional calculations: either excluded from ranking/scoring, or marked as unknown/NA. Do not forward-fill or impute missing values without explicit documentation.
certification_reason: Shares outstanding is confirmed as genuine filed-stamped history with multiple distinct filing dates per issuer. Restatement and negative-share traps are documented and the pre-registered rules to handle them are explicit. However, per-field coverage by year (2009–2026) and ticker→CIK join against the certified Norgate extension symbol list were not measured. These gaps warrant a _WITH_LIMITATIONS_ designation and must be noted for downstream executors.
limitations_that_must_travel_with_it: Field coverage by year and by issuer is not measured. Assume non-uniform coverage; smaller-cap filers may have fewer tagged facts per period. Executor must handle missing data explicitly and not assume dense coverage.

Ticker→CIK join validated at 99.4% against FSDS-derived mid/small-cap set, not against the certified Norgate extension symbol list. Estate must reconcile the two join paths and confirm no tickers are silently missing or misaligned.
96 mid/small-cap CIKs in FSDS are not yet in companyfacts.zip (0.6%); likely recent delistings or inactive filers. Estate must decide inclusion/exclusion rules and communicate them to executors.
Restatement rule (latest-filed-as-of-t) and non-positive-share filter are required; they must be pre-registered in the executor's code and not left to discovery at evaluation time.
